text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I came out shopping……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there. If you've got time to 
kill, come with me. In return, you get the 
whole dataset you've been wanting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The goods are those exclusive shoes from 
that shop. The studded 'U-MAX 226.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't get the point of in-store 
exclusives in this day and age, but if 
those are the terms, nothing I can do 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You'll be forced to line up, but I'll make 
sure there's plenty in it for you. Well? 
You in or what?
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to wait in line yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Lines make zero logical sense. Tried 
waiting in one earlier, but it just pissed 
me off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, they should've put it online from 
the start. Then we wouldn't have wasted 
all this damn time.
choice_data_list:
Why not search for an approach that suits 
you?

You should earn it with your own two 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a method that's 'like me', huh... I 
mean, there is one, but that was the first 
thing I ruled out, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, that Academy big shot gave me their 
stamp of approval. Wouldn't it be rude if 
I just sat on my ass?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalrighty then, guess I won't hold 
back... Time to do things my way to my 
heart's content, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It carried a whiff of danger, but seeing 
her drag others along at her own pace 
might be useful reference.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I figured that's the logic 
you'd roll with. What do you call it, the 
gospel of suffering? Can't stand it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, I get that you're not feelin' 
it. Gettin' a look at my data's pretty 
damn rare, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... No choice. Guess I'll gather intel 
on other shops while waiting in line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she decided to wait in line 
herself, clicking her tongue as she headed 
to the store. Just what is this 
"U-MAX226"...?
